title: Wack 100 Reacts To The News Kim Kardashian & Pete Davidson Call It Quits & If Kanye Should Take Her Back
htmlContent:
Kim Kardashian and comedian Pete Davidson ended their relationship, according to someone close to the couple.

"They did break up this week amicably due to distance and schedules," the source tells CNN.

The couple, which became official on Instagram in March and made their debut on the red carpet in May, has been connected by romance since October 2021.

In an episode of her show Hulu, Kardashian opened up about Davidson's meeting when she hosted "Saturday Night Live" and made a connection with him.

"I did 'SNL,' and then when we kissed in the scene, it was just a vibe," Kardashian said on the show noting that Davidson did not attend the after-show party. Later, she said, she decided to pursue him.

"I called the producer at 'SNL' and was like, 'Hey, do you have Pete's number?," she recounted. "And they were like, 'Yeah.' I text him. I wasn't even thinking like, 'Oh my God, I'm gonna be in a relationship with him.'"

On Saturday afternoon, Wack 100 was in Sleepless In LA and asked if he was Kanye would take Kim back.

"They got four kids.  If you ask me if I would take Kim back? No! That's just me, but the man got kids, and whatever you want to do, he wanted to do. I don't think she wants to do that. I mean, my d*** wouldn't even get hard no more. I'm a visualizer. Everywhere around the house, I'll be thinking this n***... Because you already know what n**** do because he did it before with someone else's broad. He is going to s*** a b**** out. You know what I'm saying? Off rip! I couldn't even. I couldn't even walk around the house and be comfortable like that," said Wack.

"I could not be like the piano. Yeah, over here, I couldn't. Know what I'm saying? We wouldn't even get along. Couldn't eat her p*** or nothing."

Wack would later say half of these women aren't in it for the relationship and half are opportunists. "Real s***. You have to be real with her and be like, listen, are we talking to get to know each other for romance and love?

Or are we just f***ing, and you want to do some shopping, and you want to claim you are around a n*** dude, which one? All right, cool, I'm a s*** you out. That's what it is. Don't grab my hand in public, don't do any of that. I'll let you know how it will go; that's it."
